articles.title: In final speech to armed forces, Macron urges European defence projects
articles.summary: French President Emmanuel Macron delivered his final address to armed forces on July 13, stating Europe was ready to defend itself and freedom with 'blood' if necessary, ahead of a meeting of Ukraine's allies.

articles.title: Replay: Macron speaks as Ukraine's 'Coalition of the Willing' meeting ends in Paris
articles.summary: French President Emmanuel Macron announced that Ukraine ordered 16 Rafale fighter jets and new surface-to-air defence batteries from France following a meeting of over 20 'Coalition of the Willing' leaders on July 14.

articles.title: 'The facts are there': Macron salutes fulfilling pledge to boost defence spending
articles.summary: French President Emmanuel Macron vowed France and Europe will defend freedom at all costs and praised fulfilling France's commitment to rearm during his traditional July 14 speech to the armed forces.

articles.title: Macron in Syria on first post-Assad visit by West European head of state
articles.summary: French President Emmanuel Macron visited Damascus on July 6 as the first Western European head of state to visit Syria since new authorities took power, meeting with President Ahmed al-Sharaa to discuss France's commitment to Syria's sovereignty.

articles.title: Macron's 'Versailles diplomacy' yields mixed results after a decade in power
articles.summary: French President Emmanuel Macron hosted G7 leaders at the Palace of Versailles in June, but analysts noted his diplomatic initiatives have achieved mixed results in translating symbolic gestures into lasting strategic influence.
